maria.l: Heads-up: repro for an async client bug where a tool/webhook gets invoked twice and structured output ends up duplicated in the SDK result. Anyone else seen this? :grimacing:

jason: yup. saw it with async + TypedDict tool schemas. Quick repro below.

jason: snippet:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
from typing import TypedDict

class Out(TypedDict):
    action: str
    amount: int

c = AsyncClient(api_key='redacted')

async def go():
    r = await c.generate(
        model='open-lite-1',
        prompt='invoke compute',
        tool_call={'name':'compute','args_schema':Out},
    )
    print(r.output)
```

alex: interesting — logs showed the runtime returned a 500 for the webhook, SDK retried and then parsing ran twice. So webhook side-effect executed twice.

shreya: can you paste the raw server response when it happens? Also what's the SDK version?

jason: SDK 0.8.3. raw (trimmed):
```json
{"id":"gen_abc","choices":[{"type":"tool_call","tool":"compute","tool_output":"{\"action\":\"inc\",\"amount\":3}","structured":{"action":"inc","amount":3}}],"status":200}
```

maria.l: That matches my hunch: both tool_output string and structured object present. Async parse path can race and create two parsed entries.

alex: fix idea: mark choice as parsed with an atomic guard or make parsing idempotent. Also ensure retry doesn't re-run side-effecting tool calls — maybe send idempotency token to webhook.

shreya: quick workaround: use sync client or set tool_call_parse=False and parse yourself. I'll open a ticket to add a test that stubs webhook to 500 then 200.

ci-bot: CI: integration/test-async-toolcall  failed on linux-py3.11  https://ci.redwood.example/runs/5561

alex: PR incoming with mutex around async parse + unit test to simulate retry race. Will also document interaction with RetryPolicy.

jason: tested PR locally, duplicate execution gone and TypedDict deserializes once. Thanks! :thumbsup: 

maria.l: follow-ups: 1) improve type stubs for tool_call args (overloads for TypedDict/dataclass/pydantic), 2) document tool_call_parse opt-out and sample for dataclass/TypedDict in async sample app, 3) recommend idempotency headers for webhook tools.

shreya: adding to backlog and will prioritize type-stub improvements. Closing for now  ping if you see regressions.
